wedge.title: PayPulse Africa
wedge.sector: Fintech & Payments · PayPulse Africa: Automated SME Invoicing
wedge.target_user: African SME finance manager reconciling vendor invoices and recovering overdue receivables
wedge.painful_moment: Chasing overdue invoice payments across disparate bank transfers and WhatsApp threads without automated reminders or audit trails.
wedge.unusual_constraint: Zero unhandled exceptions under upstream telco failure with deterministic local queuing and SendByte fallback.
wedge.proof_metric: Reconcile 100 sample payment records in under 2 seconds with integer-kobo precision and proof receipts
wedge.essential_sponsor_role: High-deliverability African SMS/WhatsApp transactional payment reminder rails.

adversarial_critique.why_generic_risk: Judges may see invoicing as a standard CRUD app; PayPulse proves deterministic kobo arithmetic, automated SendByte dispatch gating, and Sabilytics read telemetry.
adversarial_critique.obvious_competitor: Generic PDF invoice generators that lack automated multi-channel follow-up and African payment tracking.
adversarial_critique.unprovable_claim_risk: Claims of guaranteed 100% debt recovery; scope proof to deterministic reminder triggering upon invoice due-date threshold breaches.
adversarial_critique.superficial_sponsor_risk: Calling SendByte merely as a dummy log rather than an authenticated, idempotency-keyed reminder dispatch engine.
adversarial_critique.hour_8_kill_criterion: End-to-end invoice creation, overdue calculation, SendByte reminder dispatch payload, and Sabilytics event logging verified.
